---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, or ask for support for a new site
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is this a request to support a new site?**
If yes, which site (name + URL)? Note that only officially licensed sites
are advertised publicly, but scanlation site support may still be
considered — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of what the problem is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you'd like to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, links, examples from other tools, etc.
